source.name: Footy Headlines: Iran 2026 World Cup Home & Away Kits Released
source.quote: The Iran 2026 World Cup home kit, made by Majid, is similar to the 2022 jersey

summary: Majid kit (unveiled at an Iranian Football Federation event, May 2026). No commercial shirt sponsor: Footy Headlines' launch photos and description of the home shirt show only the Majid logo and the federation crest, with the back carrying name and number only and no other logo mentioned; SportsLogos.Net likewise names Majid as the sole manufacturer.
